title: Procedural Watershed
concept: A seeded trunk-and-tributary graph, warped into braided channels, lake-rich wetlands or dry ravines.
difference_from_base: Generates a connected branching channel graph and warps its distance field rather than taking the absolute value of a noise field as Skirmish canyon does.
intended_players: 1v1 or two teams with three symmetric orientations.
routes: Land routes and economy receive automatic tank crossings; channel depth changes the value of hover and amphibious shortcuts.
economy: Automatic mirrored resource placement, with three protected opening spots on each side. No template-specific metal-count slider.
known_weaknesses: Land map, not a dedicated naval map; no ship connectivity promise.
core_wishes: Public procedural connectivity and resource-placement helpers.
